% Pattern: label/command. A command of the paper that writes a label with a
% prefix, as \newcommand{\prlabel}[1]{\label{pr:#1}}, gives the label that
% \ref{pr:a} names. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want proposition-1 statement/proposition 1 status=here labels=pr:bounded
% want proposition-2 statement/proposition 2 status=none
% want proof-1 proof - proves=proposition-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{proposition}{Proposition}
\newcommand{\prlabel}[1]{\label{pr:#1}}
\newcommand{\prref}[1]{Proposition~\ref{pr:#1}}
\begin{document}
\begin{proposition}\prlabel{bounded} Every compact space is bounded. \end{proposition}
\begin{proposition} Every finite space is compact. \end{proposition}

\begin{proof}[Proof of \prref{bounded}]
Take a finite cover.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
